 if stat.st_nlink>1 and key in links:os.link(links[key],destination)
 else:
  shutil.copy2(source,destination)

  files={str(p.relative_to(source)):{'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(p)} for p in source.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}

  assert all(sha(source/n)==v['sha256'] for n,v in files.items())

  print('Relocated inactive cache:',source.name,flush=True)
